summary: Update pptx-manipulation skill with two critical patterns discovered in trace: (1) lxml namespace-qualified attribute setting for r:id and other prefixed attributes, which caused a ValueError when set directly, and (2) python-pptx dimension persistence bug where shape width/height changes don't survive save, requiring direct XML manipulation of a:off/a:ext elements. Added decision rules for when to fall back from python-pptx to lxml XML editing.
